theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_measure_invariant_of_density_invariant
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < n → R.Represents S → (∀ x : Euclid P, ∃ θ : ℝ, HasMassDensity S x θ) → (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ (w : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ), HasMassDensity S w θ → HasMassDensity S (y + lam • w) θ) → (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure ((fun x => y + x) ⁻¹' A) = R.measure A) ∧ ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure ((fun x => lam • x) '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ n) * R.measure A
